brief: Compare housing options using transport, utilities and other stated necessary costs.

title.es-MX: La renta no es todo el costo
title.pt-BR: Aluguel não é todo o custo

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Housing Totals"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "La renta no es todo el costo"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Aluguel não é todo o custo"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Compare housing options using transport, utilities and other stated necessary costs.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: A lower rent can come with higher necessary transport or utility costs; compare the full fictional dollar totals.
instruction.misconception: The lowest rent necessarily means the lowest total cost of living in that location.
instruction.numeracy_support: Use only the visible fictional amounts and conditions; earlier arithmetic is preparation, not a hidden financial assumption.

evidence.reasoning: Compare rent plus necessary utilities and transport over the same month. The rent alone can hide a more expensive location.
The transport difference outweighs the rent difference here.
The stated goal includes the linked necessary costs.
The total includes each stated necessary cost.
Missing necessary charges prevent a full cost comparison.
Mixed periods make totals incomparable until aligned.
The higher rent still produces the lower stated combined cost.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.

en-US.line: A lower rent can come with higher necessary transport or utility costs; compare the full fictional dollar totals.

es-MX.line: Una renta menor puede acompañarse de transporte o servicios necesarios más caros; compara totales completos en pesos ficticios.

pt-BR.line: Um aluguel menor pode vir com transporte ou serviços necessários mais caros; compare totais completos em reais fictícios.

en-US.line: Compare rent plus necessary utilities and transport over the same month. The rent alone can hide a more expensive location.

es-MX.line: Compara renta más servicios y transporte necesarios durante el mismo mes. La renta sola puede ocultar una ubicación más cara.

pt-BR.line: Compare aluguel mais serviços e transporte necessários no mesmo mês. O aluguel sozinho pode esconder um local mais caro.

feedback.met: The transport difference outweighs the rent difference here.
